summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Banner Management feature. All backend APIs (11/11 tests passed) and frontend features working correctly. Admin banners display on homepage hero carousel with proper navigation.
critical_code_review_comments: Banner Management implementation is complete and working correctly
GET /api/banners/active/homepage returns active banners with image_url and link_url
POST /api/banners/ creates banners with image_url properly saved (not empty string)
Homepage hero carousel displays admin-created banners with data-testid='hero-admin-banner'
Admin banners show first in carousel (highest priority) as type='admin_banner'
Banner click navigation works correctly - navigates to link_url (e.g., /category/refrigerator)
Banner click tracking works via POST /api/banners/{id}/track-click
Banner Management admin page shows link_url for each banner ('Links to: /category/refrigerator')
Quick Link Picker dropdown has 17 options including all categories and pages
Admin banner shows title, description, and 'Shop Now' CTA button
seed_data_creation: Test banners created during pytest execution (prefixed with TEST_) are cleaned up automatically
